description: Single source of truth mapping knowledge/<folder> collections to raw record kb_type values to Knowledge Engine KnowledgeType values. The Knowledge Engine and all ingestion scripts read this file instead of hardcoding folder names or kb_type switch statements. Adding a new document type = add an entry here + drop files in knowledge/<folder>/ + run scripts/build_index.py. No code changes required unless a genuinely new engine_type (new search index) is needed.

document_types.note: Promoted to a first-class engine_type in Sprint 2.5. Previously folded into 'procedure' with metadata.subtype='deadline' — that record-level tag is preserved for backward compatibility but is no longer required for routing.

Kept mapped to the existing 'contract' index — these ARE ready-to-use contract/document templates, not a distinct search concept. Revisit only if a future dataset needs true contract *analysis* records distinct from templates.

Derived at build time from judgment_principle.source_fields.defense_args by scripts/lib/derive_defenses.py (kb build). Regenerated on every build; not hand-authored. Zero invented content — every defense string and its supporting judgments trace back to real judgment_principle records.
No standalone contract records exist yet. Folder intentionally not created until real data lands.

how_to_add_a_type: 1. Create knowledge/<new_folder>/ and add real JSON records (array or single object per file).
2. Append an entry to document_types[] above: folder, kb_type, engine_type, id_prefix, labels.

3. If engine_type is new (not one of law/judgment/principle/procedure/contract/defense/deadline), add it to KnowledgeType in the website's api/_lib/knowledge-engine/types.ts (ALL_TYPES, TYPE_PRIORITY, TYPE_INDEX) — this is the ONLY code touch point, and it's additive, not a rewrite.
4. Run: python3 scripts/build_index.py — regenerates indexes/registry_manifest.json and per-type NDJSON automatically.

5. Website's scripts/knowledge-engine/buildIndexData.ts already walks the whole knowledge/ folder generically and now reads this registry file for kb_type -> engine_type mapping instead of a hardcoded map.
